args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r08 (summary_outlier). Its largest flank difference is at 1105 µm, against a batch median of 84 µm (z 16.4). That is well past its own 684 µm growth zone, where the curvature rate should be close to zero, so its profile has a different shape from the other roots. Its REGR peak z of -83 is not a fault on its own: the peak is only 1.23 %/h lower than the median, and the batch MAD is just 0.01. Its peak position and growth-zone length match the batch, and all of its checks pass.
Cleared: r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r07. Every check that ran passed. The large z values come from near-zero MADs and stand for small differences. Growth-zone length is 10 µm shorter in r02, r03 and r04, and the REGR peak is 0.12 %/h higher in r05 and r07. In r05 and r07 the largest flank difference is small (-0.68 %/h) and lies inside the growth zone at 295 µm. Plane sections was not run where the width-free ratio was reported.
What the flagged runs have in common: with one run flagged there is no pattern across runs. r08's fault is a flank difference, and so a curvature rate, outside the growth zone. Its checks pass, so passing checks did not catch this shape problem.
